purpose: V64 CHECK-phase step 2: preregistration of recomputation methods, frozen BEFORE any outcome metric is computed or inspected. Methods only; no outcome numbers in this file.

step_chain.step_3: recomputation exactly per analyses.qa and analyses.timing

preregistration_integrity.amendment_policy: append-only, UTC-timestamped, before corresponding results are unblinded; never silent edits

frozen_inputs.role: id-freeze sidecar: 24 ids, seed 0, data_role=confirmation_frozen, created_utc=2026-09-10T09:30:00Z
per-record outcomes: 24 lines; per arm A/B/C_cold/C_all_hit/D quality.{em,f1,presence}, ttft_median_seconds, ttft_seconds x3 repeats, backend labels
stored aggregates + timing_caveat; contains NO non-inferiority interval
runner source: hardcoded data_role L235/L443; canonical_backend default eager L222
immutable step-1 inventory: both data_role strings verbatim, per-arm label table

step_3_input_gate: re-verify every sha256 above at step-3 start; on any mismatch stop and re-inventory; never recompute on drifted inputs
frozen_record_ids_source: experiments/v60_confirmation_manifest.json (sha 2dffebf5...); ids fixed, no substitutions, no exclusions

qa.name: QA paired non-inferiority recomputation
qa.exclusions: none; missing/unparsable per-record entry aborts the analysis with count reconciliation against 24; records never silently dropped
qa.metrics_source: requests.jsonl arms.*.quality.{em,f1} exactly as stored; presence reported but outside the decision rule; no post-hoc metric changes

contrasts.definition: arm B (canonical_per_document_ddi_qf, cache=disabled, standard) minus arm A (original_monolithic_ddi_qf, standard)
arm C (all_hit scenario) minus arm A
arm C (cold scenario) minus arm A

qa.point_estimate: mean of per-record paired deltas d_i = canonical_i - A_i, per metric per contrast

interval.rng: numpy.random.default_rng(47) (PCG64), fresh instance for this analysis
interval.resampling: records with replacement; single index matrix rng.integers(0, 24, size=(10000, 24)) drawn once and shared by EM and F1 (paired)

decision_rule.rule: non-inferiority holds iff CI lower bound >= -0.02 for BOTH em and f1 (mirrors the original -0.02 floor)

classification.inconclusive: rule not satisfied but mean delta >= 0 for both metrics (direction favorable, underpowered)
classification.fail: rule not satisfied and mean delta < 0 for either metric

decision_rule.co_reported_rule: same rule applied to co-reported contrasts, reported alongside; headline verdict is the primary only; no gate-shopping

qa.context: stored aggregates contain no non-inferiority interval; step 3 produces the first one from raw per-record outcomes only

timing.name: TTFT timing recomputation
timing.median_definition: median over the 24 per-record arms.<X>.ttft_median_seconds (each the median of its 3 stored ttft_seconds repeats); same definition under which the stored aggregates recompute

ratios.note: the quantity behind the falsified Tracker claim B->C 1.77x
preregistered because C-is-X-times-A vs A-is-X-times-C reciprocal confusion is part of the 1.77x defect

interval.rng: fresh numpy.random.default_rng(47); single index matrix rng.integers(0, 24, size=(10000, 24)) drawn once and shared by ALL ratios in this analysis
interval.resampling: records with replacement, paired across arms; per resample each arm's median TTFT recomputed from resampled records' ttft_median_seconds, then the ratio

timing.gate: none: descriptive reconstructions only; numbers attach to the step-4 claims table (esp. adjudicating B->C 1.77x)
explicit_non_goals: mean of per-request paired latency ratios is NOT computed (not preregistered, not needed for the claims)
no V61 grid recomputation in this step

data_role.conflict: run manifest.json/result.json data_role='development' (+ data_role_note 'must never serve as untouched confirmation') vs experiments/v60_confirmation_manifest.json data_role='confirmation_frozen'; both verbatim strings recorded in immutable step-1 INVENTORY.json
data_role.adjudication: data_role=confirmation_frozen is authoritative because the id-freeze preceded execution: freeze manifest (sha 2dffebf5..., created_utc 2026-09-10T09:30:00Z) predates the run artifact (results dir stamped 20260910T093500Z)
data_role.runner_label: the 'development' string is a hardcoded runner default (scripts/run_canonical_qa_dev.py L235/L443, unconditional dict literals); recorded as a provenance defect, NOT as evidence of contamination
data_role.scope_limit: genuine untouched status (id intersections vs V58/V60/V61 observed manifests, observed_exclusion_count=100) is checklist item 2's separate question, decided on its own evidence; this rule only adjudicates which label is authoritative for the frozen-id question

backend_labels.authoritative_source: per-request records: requests.jsonl arms[*].backend, identical across all 24 records
backend_labels.executed_backend: sdpa for all five arms (A, B, C_cold, C_all_hit, D)
backend_labels.consequence: A-vs-B/C is a same-backend comparison (monolithic vs canonical execution); the runner default canonical_backend='eager' (L222, overridden by --canonical-on-sdpa) explains the narrative; retained outputs (B/C = 'sdpa') show --canonical-on-sdpa was in effect
backend_labels.defects: narrative 'eager' claims for the canonical arms, wherever they appear, are metadata defects entered in the step-4 claims table; per-request records always outrank narrative
backend_labels.corollary: result.json timing_caveat 'cross-backend comparisons are inadmissible' rests on a mislabeled premise (comparison is same-backend); caveat preserved verbatim in the inventory, wording corrected in step 4

claims_table_skeleton.rows_policy: no row may be added or dropped post hoc; corrected_text and evidence_sha filled only in step 4 from step-3 recomputation

rows.prior_text: '+.0417' (prose only: V59-V63-CONSOLIDATED-REVIEW.md:67; VIBEQUEUE-64 description; no stored aggregate key)
never stored in any artifact; only point estimates exist

reporting.precision: EM/F1 deltas and CIs 6 decimals; TTFT ms 4 decimals; ratios 4 decimals; CIs as [lower, upper]
reporting.determinism: RNG type, seed, draw order, shared index matrices, and quantile method fully pinned; a rerun on the same pinned inputs must reproduce every number bit-for-bit
reporting.verdict_policy: step 3 reports frozen decision-rule verdicts verbatim including unfavorable ones; underpowered/inconclusive is recorded, the test is never altered, no observations added opportunistically

rollback.side_effects: none: no existing file edited, no GPU, no Tracker
rollback.self_sha_note: sha256 of both files printed in the step-2 completion output (session log); not self-embedded
